title: Midtown Manhattan: Times Square & Skyscrapers Walking Tour
includes: Inside visit to Grand Central Terminal
Guided walking tour of Midtown Manhattan
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Go beyond the postcard views and discover the stories that transformed Midtown Manhattan into the heart of New York City. Rather than simply stopping for photos, your expert local guide reveals the history, architecture, and fascinating people behind the city's most recognizable landmarks.

Step inside Grand Central Terminal to admire its spectacular celestial ceiling, uncover the rivalry that fueled New York's legendary skyscraper race, and learn how Fifth Avenue, Park Avenue, Rockefeller Center, and Times Square became symbols of the city’s ambition and innovation.

Along the way, experience the contrast between Midtown's bustling streets and its hidden architectural treasures, gaining a deeper appreciation for the history and stories that millions of visitors pass by every year.
